discoveries.headline: The back of a 1942 draft card, probably Harry James Farr's, describes a man 5 feet 7 inches tall, 142 pounds, with blue eyes, brown hair and a ruddy complexion, registered on April 27, 1942 at Woodstock, Vermont; it is matched to him only by its place after his front card.

source.text: U.S., World War II Draft Registration Cards, 1942 (Ancestry, back of the record 611960 card, image 3109 of 6398; the front is image 3108): registrar's report dated 27 Apr 1942, Local Board 2, Windsor County, Woodstock, Vermont

discoveries.imageAlt: Back of a 1942 draft card (image 3109 of 6398, probably Harry James Farr): 5 feet 7 inches, 142 pounds, blue eyes, brown hair, ruddy, April 27, 1942, Woodstock
